    opt.add(order[i] >= 0)
    opt.add(order[i] <= n)
    opt.add(Implies(meet[i], And(order[i] >= 1, order[i] <= n)))
    opt.add(Implies(Not(meet[i]), order[i] == 0))
    opt.add(Implies(meet[i], start[i] >= win_start[i]))
    opt.add(Implies(meet[i], end[i] == start[i] + dur[i]))
    opt.add(Implies(meet[i], end[i] <= win_end[i]))
    opt.add(Implies(meet[i], start[i] >= 0))
    opt.add(Implies(Not(meet[i]), start[i] == 0))
    opt.add(Implies(Not(meet[i]), end[i] == 0))

for i in range(n):

def check_order(order):
    if len(order) == 0:

    s = Solver()

        if i == 0:

from z3 import *

# Locations: 0 Haight-Ashbury, 1 Russian Hill, 2 Fisherman's Wharf,
# 3 Nob Hill, 4 Golden Gate Park, 5 Alamo Square, 6 Pacific Heights
locations = [
    "Haight-Ashbury",
    "Russian Hill",
    "Fisherman's Wharf",
    "Nob Hill",
    "Golden Gate Park",
    "Alamo Square",
    "Pacific Heights"
]

travel = [
    [0, 17, 23, 15, 7, 5, 12],   # Haight-Ashbury
    [17, 0, 7, 5, 21, 15, 7],    # Russian Hill
    [22, 7, 0, 11, 25, 20, 12],  # Fisherman's Wharf
    [13, 5, 11, 0, 17, 11, 8],   # Nob Hill
    [7, 19, 24, 20, 0, 10, 16],  # Golden Gate Park
    [5, 13, 19, 11, 9, 0, 10],   # Alamo Square
    [11, 7, 13, 8, 15, 10, 0]    # Pacific Heights
]

names = ["Stephanie", "Kevin", "Robert", "Steven", "Anthony", "Sandra"]
loc_idx = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
duration = [15, 75, 90, 75, 15, 45]
avail_start = [1200, 1155, 465, 510, 465, 885]
avail_end = [1245, 1305, 630, 1020, 1185, 1305]

n = len(names)
dummy = n

solver = Optimize()

# at[p][i] means friend i is met at position p; at[p][dummy] means no meeting at p
at = [[Bool(f"at_{p}_{i}") for i in range(n + 1)] for p in range(n)]

# Each position has exactly one value: a friend or dummy
for p in range(n):
    solver.add(Sum([If(at[p][i], 1, 0) for i in range(n + 1)]) == 1)

# Each friend is met at most once
for i in range(n):
    solver.add(Sum([If(at[p][i], 1, 0) for p in range(n)]) <= 1)

# Once a dummy appears, all later positions are dummy
for p in range(n - 1):
    solver.add(Implies(at[p][dummy], at[p + 1][dummy]))

t = [Int(f"t_{p}") for p in range(n)]
for p in range(n):
    solver.add(t[p] >= 0)
    solver.add(t[p] <= 1440)

# Availability and duration constraints
for p in range(n):
    for i in range(n):
        solver.add(Implies(at[p][i], t[p] >= avail_start[i]))
        solver.add(Implies(at[p][i], t[p] + duration[i] <= avail_end[i]))

# Travel from start to first meeting
for i in range(n):
    solver.add(Implies(at[0][i], t[0] >= 540 + travel[0][loc_idx[i]]))

# Travel between consecutive meetings
for p in range(1, n):
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            solver.add(Implies(
                And(at[p - 1][j], at[p][i]),
                t[p] >= t[p - 1] + duration[j] + travel[loc_idx[j]][loc_idx[i]]
            ))

# Maximize the number of friends met
count = Sum([If(at[p][i], 1, 0) for p in range(n) for i in range(n)])
solver.maximize(count)

def fmt(mins):
    h = mins // 60
    m = mins % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{m:02d}{suffix}"

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()
    itinerary = ["You start at Haight-Ashbury at 9:00AM."]

    prev_time = 540
    prev_loc = 0

    for p in range(n):
        found = -1
        for i in range(n):
            if is_true(model.evaluate(at[p][i], model_completion=True)):
                found = i
                break

        if found == -1:
            continue

        curr_loc = loc_idx[found]
        travel_time = travel[prev_loc][curr_loc]
        arrival = prev_time + travel_time
        start = model.evaluate(t[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        end = start + duration[found]

        itinerary.append(
            f"You travel to {locations[curr_loc]} in {travel_time} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrival)}."
        )
        if start > arrival:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(start)}.")
        itinerary.append(
            f"You meet {names[found]} from {fmt(start)} to {fmt(end)}."
        )

        prev_time = end
        prev_loc = curr_loc

    print(itinerary)

names = list(friends.keys())
meet = {name: Bool("meet_" + name.replace(" ", "_").replace("'", "")) for name in names}
start = {name: Int("start_" + name.replace(" ", "_").replace("'", "")) for name in names}

def add_common(opt):
    for name, f in friends.items():
        opt.add(Implies(meet[name], start[name] >= f["avail_start"]))
        opt.add(Implies(meet[name], start[name] + f["dur"] <= f["avail_end"]))
        opt.add(Implies(meet[name], start[name] >= START + travel["Marina District"][f["loc"]]))
    for i, a in enumerate(names):
        for b in names[i + 1:]:
            fa = friends[a]
            fb = friends[b]
            both = And(meet[a], meet[b])
            a_before_b = start[b] >= start[a] + fa["dur"] + travel[fa["loc"]][fb["loc"]]
            b_before_a = start[a] >= start[b] + fb["dur"] + travel[fb["loc"]][fa["loc"]]
            opt.add(Implies(both, Or(a_before_b, b_before_a)))
    return Sum([If(meet[name], 1, 0) for name in names])

opt1 = Optimize()
count1 = add_common(opt1)
opt1.maximize(count1)
opt1.check()
m1 = opt1.model()
best_count = sum(1 for name in names if is_true(m1.eval(meet[name])))

opt2 = Optimize()
count2 = add_common(opt2)
opt2.add(count2 == best_count)
finish = Int("finish")
opt2.add(finish >= START)
for name, f in friends.items():
    opt2.add(Implies(meet[name], finish >= start[name] + f["dur"]))
opt2.minimize(finish)
opt2.check()
m = opt2.model()

met = [name for name in names if is_true(m.eval(meet[name]))]
met.sort(key=lambda name: m.eval(start[name]).as_long())

def fmt(t):
    t = int(t)
    h = (t // 60) % 24
    mnt = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    hh = h % 12
    if hh == 0:
        hh = 12
    return f"{hh}:{mnt:02d}{suffix}"

steps = [f"You start at Marina District at {fmt(START)}."]
cur_time = START
cur_loc = "Marina District"
for name in met:
    f = friends[name]
    loc = f["loc"]
    tt = travel[cur_loc][loc]
    arrival = cur_time + tt
    st = max(arrival, f["avail_start"])
    en = st + f["dur"]
    steps.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {tt} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrival)}.")
    if arrival < st:
        steps.append(f"You wait until {fmt(st)}.")
    steps.append(f"You meet {name} for {f['dur']} minutes from {fmt(st)} to {fmt(en)}.")
    cur_time = en
    cur_loc = loc

print(steps)

from z3 import *

names = ["Jeffrey", "Ronald", "Jason", "Melissa", "Elizabeth", "Margaret", "George", "Richard", "Laura"]
locations = ["Presidio", "Fisherman's Wharf", "Alamo Square", "Financial District", "Union Square",

loc_idx = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]
durations = [90, 120, 105, 15, 105, 90, 75, 15, 60]
opens = [615, 465, 645, 1065, 885, 795, 1140, 570, 585]
closes = [780, 885, 960, 1095, 1050, 1140, 1320, 1260, 1080]

travel = [
    [0, 19, 19, 23, 22, 15, 20, 12, 21, 7],
    [17, 0, 21, 11, 13, 27, 8, 25, 12, 18],
    [17, 19, 0, 17, 14, 16, 16, 9, 15, 11],
    [22, 10, 17, 0, 9, 30, 4, 23, 5, 21],
    [24, 15, 15, 9, 0, 27, 11, 22, 7, 20],

    [20, 6, 19, 5, 10, 30, 0, 25, 7, 21],
    [11, 24, 9, 26, 22, 10, 25, 0, 23, 7],
    [19, 8, 17, 5, 7, 29, 5, 23, 0, 20],
    [7, 18, 13, 22, 21, 11, 19, 9, 20, 0]
]

n = len(names)
met = [Bool(f"met_{i}") for i in range(n)]
start = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(n)]
end = [Int(f"end_{i}") for i in range(n)]
pos = [Int(f"pos_{i}") for i in range(n)]

opt = Optimize()
total_met = Sum([If(met[i], 1, 0) for i in range(n)])

for i in range(n):
    opt.add(pos[i] >= 0)
    opt.add(pos[i] <= n)
    opt.add(end[i] == start[i] + durations[i])
    opt.add(Implies(met[i], start[i] >= opens[i]))
    opt.add(Implies(met[i], start[i] + durations[i] <= closes[i]))
    opt.add(Implies(met[i], pos[i] >= 1))
    opt.add(Implies(met[i], pos[i] <= total_met))

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i + 1, n):
        opt.add(Implies(And(met[i], met[j]), pos[i] != pos[j]))

for i in range(n):
    opt.add(Implies(And(met[i], pos[i] == 1),
                    start[i] >= 540 + travel[0][loc_idx[i]]))

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if i != j:
            opt.add(Implies(And(met[i], met[j], pos[i] == pos[j] + 1),
                            start[i] >= end[j] + travel[loc_idx[j]][loc_idx[i]]))

opt.maximize(total_met)

if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()

    def fmt(mins):
        mins = int(mins)
        h = mins // 60
        mm = mins % 60
        suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"

        if h12 == 0:
            h12 = 12
        return f"{h12}:{mm:02d}{suffix}"

    meetings = []
    for i in range(n):
        if is_true(m.eval(met[i], model_completion=True)):
            st = m.eval(start[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
            en = st + durations[i]
            meetings.append((st, en, i))

    meetings.sort()

    statements = []
    statements.append(f"You start at Presidio at {fmt(540)}.")

    cur_loc = 0
    cur_time = 540

    for st, en, i in meetings:
        target_loc = loc_idx[i]
        travel_time = travel[cur_loc][target_loc]
        arrive = cur_time + travel_time

        statements.append(
            f"You travel to {locations[target_loc]} in {travel_time} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}."
        )

        if st > arrive:
            statements.append(f"You wait until {fmt(st)}.")

        statements.append(
            f"You meet {names[i]} for {durations[i]} minutes from {fmt(st)} to {fmt(en)}."
        )

        cur_loc = target_loc
        cur_time = en

from z3 import *

friends = ["Emily", "Barbara", "William"]
loc = {"Emily": "Alamo Square", "Barbara": "Union Square", "William": "Chinatown"}
open_t = {"Emily": 11*60 + 45, "Barbara": 16*60 + 45, "William": 17*60 + 15}
close_t = {"Emily": 15*60 + 15, "Barbara": 18*60 + 15, "William": 19*60}
min_dur = {"Emily": 105, "Barbara": 60, "William": 105}
travel = {
    ("The Castro", "Alamo Square"): 8,
    ("The Castro", "Union Square"): 19,
    ("The Castro", "Chinatown"): 20,
    ("Alamo Square", "The Castro"): 8,
    ("Alamo Square", "Union Square"): 14,
    ("Alamo Square", "Chinatown"): 16,
    ("Union Square", "The Castro"): 19,
    ("Union Square", "Alamo Square"): 15,
    ("Union Square", "Chinatown"): 7,
    ("Chinatown", "The Castro"): 22,
    ("Chinatown", "Alamo Square"): 17,
    ("Chinatown", "Union Square"): 7,
}
start_time = 9*60
start_loc = "The Castro"

solver = Optimize()
sel = {f: Bool(f"sel_{f}") for f in friends}
start = {f: Int(f"start_{f}") for f in friends}
end = {f: Int(f"end_{f}") for f in friends}

    solver.add(Implies(sel[f], end[f] <= close_t[f]))
    solver.add(Implies(sel[f], end[f] - start[f] >= min_dur[f]))
    solver.add(Implies(sel[f], start[f] >= start_time + travel[(start_loc, loc[f])]))

        solver.add(Implies(And(sel[a], sel[b]), Or(
            start[b] >= end[a] + travel[(loc[a], loc[b])],
            start[a] >= end[b] + travel[(loc[b], loc[a])]
        )))

score = 0
for f in friends:
    score = score + If(sel[f], 100000 + end[f] - start[f], 0)
solver.maximize(score)

res = solver.check()
assert res == sat
m = solver.model()

chosen = []
for f in friends:
    if is_true(m.eval(sel[f], model_completion=True)):
        st = m.eval(start[f], model_completion=True).as_long()
        en = m.eval(end[f], model_completion=True).as_long()
        chosen.append((st, en, f))
chosen.sort()

def fmt(t):
    h = (t // 60) % 24
    mnt = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{mnt:02d}{suffix}"

itinerary = [f"You start at {start_loc} at {fmt(start_time)}."]
current_time = start_time
current_loc = start_loc
for st, en, f in chosen:
    dest = loc[f]
    duration = travel[(current_loc, dest)]
    arrival = current_time + duration
    itinerary.append(f"You travel to {dest} in {duration} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrival)}.")
    if arrival < st:
        itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(st)}.")
    itinerary.append(f"You meet {f} from {fmt(st)} to {fmt(en)}.")
    current_time = en
    current_loc = dest

from z3 import *

start_time = 9 * 60

b_start = Int('b_start')
b_end = Int('b_end')
k_start = Int('k_start')
k_end = Int('k_end')
meet_b = Bool('meet_b')
meet_k = Bool('meet_k')
first_b = Bool('first_b')

def add_constraints(o):
    o.add(b_start >= 0, b_start <= 24 * 60)
    o.add(b_end >= 0, b_end <= 24 * 60)
    o.add(k_start >= 0, k_start <= 24 * 60)
    o.add(k_end >= 0, k_end <= 24 * 60)

    o.add(Implies(meet_b, And(
        b_start >= 8 * 60 + 15,
        b_end == b_start + 45,
        b_end <= 19 * 60
    )))
    o.add(Implies(meet_k, And(
        k_start >= 12 * 60,
        k_end == k_start + 90,
        k_end <= 15 * 60
    )))

    both = And(meet_b, meet_k)
    o.add(Implies(both, Or(
        And(first_b,
            b_start >= start_time + 23,
            k_start >= b_end + 23),
        And(Not(first_b),
            k_start >= start_time + 5,
            b_start >= k_end + 23)
    )))

    o.add(Implies(And(meet_b, Not(meet_k)), b_start >= start_time + 23))
    o.add(Implies(And(meet_k, Not(meet_b)), k_start >= start_time + 5))

score = If(meet_b, 1, 0) + If(meet_k, 1, 0)

opt1 = Optimize()
add_constraints(opt1)
opt1.maximize(score)
opt1.check()
m1 = opt1.model()
max_meet = m1.eval(score).as_long()

last_end = If(meet_b,
              If(meet_k,
                 If(first_b, k_end, b_end),
                 b_end),
              If(meet_k, k_end, start_time))

opt2 = Optimize()
add_constraints(opt2)
opt2.add(score == max_meet)
opt2.minimize(last_end)
opt2.check()
m2 = opt2.model()
min_last_end = m2.eval(last_end).as_long()

sum_starts = If(meet_b, b_start, 0) + If(meet_k, k_start, 0)

opt3 = Optimize()
add_constraints(opt3)
opt3.add(score == max_meet)
opt3.add(last_end == min_last_end)
opt3.minimize(sum_starts)
opt3.check()
m = opt3.model()

meet_b_val = is_true(m.eval(meet_b, model_completion=True))
meet_k_val = is_true(m.eval(meet_k, model_completion=True))
first_b_val = is_true(m.eval(first_b, model_completion=True))
b_start_val = m.eval(b_start, model_completion=True).as_long()
b_end_val = m.eval(b_end, model_completion=True).as_long()
k_start_val = m.eval(k_start, model_completion=True).as_long()
k_end_val = m.eval(k_end, model_completion=True).as_long()

def fmt(t):
    t = int(t) % (24 * 60)
    h = t // 60
    minute = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

itinerary = []
itinerary.append(f"You start at Financial District at {fmt(start_time)}.")

if meet_b_val and meet_k_val:
    if first_b_val:
        arrival1 = start_time + 23
        itinerary.append(f"You travel to Golden Gate Park in 23 minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrival1)}.")
        if b_start_val > arrival1:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(b_start_val)}.")
        itinerary.append(f"You meet Barbara from {fmt(b_start_val)} to {fmt(b_end_val)}.")
        arrival2 = b_end_val + 23

    s = Solver()
    slot = [Int(f'slot_{k}') for k in range(N)]
    start = [Int(f'start_{k}') for k in range(N)]
    for k in range(N):
        s.add(slot[k] >= -1, slot[k] < N)
        s.add(start[k] >= 0, start[k] <= 2000)
    for k in range(N-1):
        s.add(Implies(slot[k] == -1, slot[k+1] == -1))
    for i in range(N):
        s.add(Sum([If(slot[k] == i, 1, 0) for k in range(N)]) <= 1)
    # count exact
    s.add(Sum([If(slot[k] != -1, 1, 0) for k in range(N)]) == count)
    # first slot
    for i, (name, loc, op, cl, dur) in enumerate(friends):
        s.add(Implies(slot[0] == i, start[0] >= 540 + travel["The Castro"][loc]))
    # transition
    for k in range(N-1):
        for i, (name_i, loc_i, op_i, cl_i, dur_i) in enumerate(friends):
            for j, (name_j, loc_j, op_j, cl_j, dur_j) in enumerate(friends):
                if i == j:
                    continue
                s.add(Implies(And(slot[k] == i, slot[k+1] == j),
                              start[k+1] >= start[k] + dur_i + travel[loc_i][loc_j]))
    # availability
    for k in range(N):
        for i, (name, loc, op, cl, dur) in enumerate(friends):
            s.add(Implies(slot[k] == i, And(start[k] >= op, start[k] + dur <= cl)))
    if s.check() == sat:
        model = s.model()
        max_count = count
        break

# get sequence
seq = []
for k in range(N):
    v = model.eval(slot[k], model_completion=True).as_long()
    if v >= 0:
        seq.append(v)

# compute itinerary

prev_time = 540
prev_loc = "The Castro"
for idx in seq:
    name, loc, op, cl, dur = friends[idx]
    tr = travel[prev_loc][loc]
    arrival = prev_time + tr

    itinerary.append(f"You meet {name} for {dur} minutes from {fmt(meet_start)} to {fmt(meet_end)}.")
    prev_time = meet_end

from z3 import *
from itertools import permutations

friends = [...]
travel = {...}
start_loc = "Financial District"
start_time = 9*60

def travel_time(a,b):
    return travel[(a,b)]

def fmt(t):
    h = t // 60
    m = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    hh = h % 12
    if hh == 0:
        hh = 12
    return f"{hh}:{m:02d}{suffix}"

def build_itinerary(perm, starts):
    statements=[]
    statements.append(f"You start at {start_loc} at {fmt(start_time)}.")
    current_loc = start_loc
    current_time = start_time
    for pos, idx in enumerate(perm):
        f = friends[idx]
        loc = f["loc"]
        tt = travel[(current_loc, loc)]
        arrival = current_time + tt
        statements.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {tt} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrival)}.")
        ms = starts[pos]
        if ms > arrival:
            statements.append(f"You wait until {fmt(ms)}.")
        me = ms + f["dur"]
        statements.append(f"You meet {f['name']} for {f['dur']} minutes from {fmt(ms)} to {fmt(me)}.")
        current_loc = loc
        current_time = me
    return statements

def solve_perm(perm):
    L = len(perm)
    if L == 0:
        return []
    opt = Optimize()
    s = [Int(f"s_{i}") for i in range(L)]
    for k, idx in enumerate(perm):
        f = friends[idx]
        opt.add(s[k] >= f["start"])
        opt.add(s[k] + f["dur"] <= f["end"])
    first = friends[perm[0]]
    opt.add(s[0] >= start_time + travel[(start_loc, first["loc"])])
    for k in range(1, L):
        prev = friends[perm[k-1]]
        curr = friends[perm[k]]
        opt.add(s[k] >= s[k-1] + prev["dur"] + travel[(prev["loc"], curr["loc"])])
    opt.minimize(Sum(s))
    if opt.check() == sat:

def solve_perm(perm):
    L = len(perm)

    opt = Optimize()
    s = [Int(f"s_{i}") for i in range(L)]

        return [m.evaluate(s[k]).as_long() for k in range(L)]

from z3 import *
from itertools import permutations

friends = [
    {"name": "Melissa", "loc": "Golden Gate Park", "avail_start": 8 * 60 + 30, "avail_end": 20 * 60, "dur": 15},
    {"name": "Nancy", "loc": "Presidio", "avail_start": 19 * 60 + 45, "avail_end": 22 * 60, "dur": 105},
    {"name": "Emily", "loc": "Richmond District", "avail_start": 16 * 60 + 45, "avail_end": 22 * 60, "dur": 120},
]

travel = {
    "Fisherman's Wharf": {
        "Golden Gate Park": 25,
        "Presidio": 17,
        "Richmond District": 18,
    },
    "Golden Gate Park": {
        "Fisherman's Wharf": 24,
        "Presidio": 11,
        "Richmond District": 7,
    },
    "Presidio": {
        "Fisherman's Wharf": 19,
        "Golden Gate Park": 12,
        "Richmond District": 7,
    },
    "Richmond District": {
        "Fisherman's Wharf": 18,
        "Golden Gate Park": 9,
        "Presidio": 7,
    },
}

n = len(friends)
met = [Bool(f"met_{i}") for i in range(n)]
start = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(n)]

cases = []
for r in range(n + 1):
    for perm in permutations(range(n), r):
        cases.append(list(perm))

sel = [Bool(f"sel_{i}") for i in range(len(cases))]
solver = Optimize()
solver.add(Sum([If(sel[i], 1, 0) for i in range(len(cases))]) == 1)

for ci, order in enumerate(cases):
    cond = sel[ci]
    for fi in range(n):
        if fi in order:
            solver.add(Implies(cond, met[fi]))
        else:
            solver.add(Implies(cond, Not(met[fi])))
    for k, fi in enumerate(order):
        f = friends[fi]
        if k == 0:
            first_travel = travel["Fisherman's Wharf"][f["loc"]]
            solver.add(Implies(cond, start[fi] >= 9 * 60 + first_travel))
        else:
            prev_i = order[k - 1]
            prev = friends[prev_i]
            tt = travel[prev["loc"]][f["loc"]]
            solver.add(Implies(cond, start[fi] >= start[prev_i] + prev["dur"] + tt))
        solver.add(Implies(cond, start[fi] >= f["avail_start"]))
        solver.add(Implies(cond, start[fi] + f["dur"] <= f["avail_end"]))

solver.maximize(Sum([If(met[i], 1, 0) for i in range(n)]))
assert solver.check() == sat
model = solver.model()

    if is_true(model.eval(sel[ci], model_completion=True)):
        selected_case = cases[ci]
        break

    itinerary.append(f"You meet {f['name']} from {fmt(meeting_start)} to {fmt(meeting_end)}.")

start_time = 540

travel = { ... }

p = [Int(f'p_{k}') for k in range(N)]
s = [Int(f's_{k}') for k in range(N)]

def add_constraints(solver):
    for k in range(N):
        solver.add(p[k] >= 0, p[k] <= 9)
        solver.add(s[k] >= 0, s[k] <= 1440)
    for k in range(N-1):
        solver.add(Implies(p[k] == 0, p[k+1] == 0))
    for f in range(1, 10):
        solver.add(Sum([If(p[k] == f, 1, 0) for k in range(N)]) <= 1)
    for k in range(N):
        for f in range(1, 10):
            solver.add(Implies(p[k] == f,
                And(s[k] >= avail_start[f],
                    s[k] + dur[f] <= avail_end[f])))
    # first origin
    for f in range(1, 10):
        solver.add(Implies(p[0] == f,
            s[0] >= start_min + travel["Marina District"][friend_loc[f]]))
    for k in range(1, N):
        for g in range(1, 10):
            for f in range(1, 10):
                solver.add(Implies(And(p[k-1] == g, p[k] == f),
                    s[k] >= s[k-1] + dur[g] + travel[friend_loc[g]][friend_loc[f]]))

met_count = Sum([If(p[k] > 0, 1, 0) for k in range(N)])

opt = Optimize()
add_constraints(opt)
opt.maximize(met_count)
if opt.check() == sat:

    max_count = m0.eval(met_count).as_long()

from z3 import *

loc_names = [
    "Marina District", "Bayview", "Sunset District", "Richmond District", "Nob Hill",
    "Chinatown", "Haight-Ashbury", "North Beach", "Russian Hill", "Embarcadero"
]
loc_index = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(loc_names)}

travel = [
    [0, 27, 19, 11, 12, 15, 16, 11, 8, 14],
    [27, 0, 23, 25, 20, 19, 19, 22, 23, 19],
    [21, 22, 0, 12, 27, 30, 15, 28, 24, 30],
    [9, 27, 11, 0, 17, 20, 10, 17, 13, 19],
    [11, 19, 24, 14, 0, 6, 13, 8, 5, 9],
    [12, 20, 29, 20, 9, 0, 19, 3, 7, 5],
    [17, 18, 15, 10, 15, 19, 0, 19, 17, 20],
    [9, 25, 27, 18, 7, 6, 18, 0, 4, 6],
    [7, 23, 23, 14, 5, 9, 17, 5, 0, 8],
    [12, 21, 30, 21, 10, 7, 21, 5, 8, 0]
]

friends = [
    {"name": "Charles", "loc": "Bayview", "start": 690, "end": 870, "dur": 45},
    {"name": "Robert", "loc": "Sunset District", "start": 1005, "end": 1260, "dur": 30},
    {"name": "Karen", "loc": "Richmond District", "start": 1155, "end": 1290, "dur": 60},
    {"name": "Rebecca", "loc": "Nob Hill", "start": 975, "end": 1230, "dur": 90},
    {"name": "Margaret", "loc": "Chinatown", "start": 855, "end": 1185, "dur": 120},
    {"name": "Patricia", "loc": "Haight-Ashbury", "start": 870, "end": 1230, "dur": 45},
    {"name": "Mark", "loc": "North Beach", "start": 840, "end": 1110, "dur": 105},
    {"name": "Melissa", "loc": "Russian Hill", "start": 780, "end": 1185, "dur": 30},
    {"name": "Laura", "loc": "Embarcadero", "start": 465, "end": 795, "dur": 105}
]

n = len(friends)
start_min = 9 * 60
marina = loc_index["Marina District"]

at = [[Bool(f"at_{p}_{f}") for f in range(n)] for p in range(n)]
dummy = [Bool(f"dummy_{p}") for p in range(n)]
start = [Int(f"start_{p}") for p in range(n)]
end = [Int(f"end_{p}") for p in range(n)]

opt = Optimize()

for p in range(n):
    opt.add(Sum([If(at[p][f], 1, 0) for f in range(n)]) + If(dummy[p], 1, 0) == 1)
    opt.add(start[p] >= 0)
    opt.add(start[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(end[p] >= 0)
    opt.add(end[p] <= 1440)

for f in range(n):
    opt.add(Sum([If(at[p][f], 1, 0) for p in range(n)]) <= 1)

for p in range(n - 1):
    opt.add(Implies(dummy[p], dummy[p + 1]))

for f, fr in enumerate(friends):
    loc = loc_index[fr["loc"]]
    opt.add(Implies(at[0][f], start[0] >= start_min + travel[marina][loc]))

for p in range(n):
    for f, fr in enumerate(friends):
        opt.add(Implies(at[p][f], start[p] >= fr["start"]))
        opt.add(Implies(at[p][f], end[p] <= fr["end"]))
        opt.add(Implies(at[p][f], end[p] == start[p] + fr["dur"]))

for p in range(1, n):
    for f, frf in enumerate(friends):
        for g, frg in enumerate(friends):
            opt.add(Implies(
                And(at[p - 1][g], at[p][f]),
                start[p] >= end[p - 1] + travel[loc_index[frg["loc"]]][loc_index[frf["loc"]]]
            ))

count = Sum([If(at[p][f], 1, 0) for p in range(n) for f in range(n)])
opt.maximize(count)

if opt.check() != sat:
    raise Exception("No solution found")

model = opt.model()

sequence = []
for p in range(n):
    chosen = None
    for f in range(n):
        if is_true(model.eval(at[p][f], model_completion=True)):
            chosen = f
            break
    if chosen is not None:
        st = model.eval(start[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        en = model.eval(end[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        sequence.append((chosen, st, en))


def fmt(t):
    t = int(t)
    hour = t // 60
    minute = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if hour < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = hour % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"


itinerary = [f"You start at Marina District at {fmt(start_min)}."]
current_loc = marina
current_time = start_min

for f, st, en in sequence:
    fr = friends[f]
    dest = loc_index[fr["loc"]]
    duration = travel[current_loc][dest]
    arrival = current_time + duration

    itinerary.append(
        f"You travel to {fr['loc']} in {duration} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrival)}."
    )

    if st > arrival:
        itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(st)}.")

    itinerary.append(
        f"You meet {fr['name']} for {en - st} minutes from {fmt(st)} to {fmt(en)}."
    )

    current_loc = dest
    current_time = en

print(itinerary)

from z3 import *

def fmt_time(m):
    m = int(m)
    h = m // 60
    minute = m % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

durs = [...]
location_names = [...]

N = len(names)

opt = Optimize()
friend_vars = [Int(f"friend_{p}") for p in range(N)]
start_vars = [Int(f"start_{p}") for p in range(N)]

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(friend_vars[p] >= -1)
    opt.add(friend_vars[p] < N)
    opt.add(start_vars[p] >= 0)
    opt.add(start_vars[p] <= 2000)

for p in range(N - 1):
    opt.add(Implies(friend_vars[p] == -1, friend_vars[p + 1] == -1))

for f in range(N):
    opt.add(Sum([If(friend_vars[p] == f, 1, 0) for p in range(N)]) <= 1)

for p in range(N):
    for f in range(N):
        opt.add(Implies(friend_vars[p] == f, start_vars[p] >= opens[f]))
        opt.add(Implies(friend_vars[p] == f, start_vars[p] + durs[f] <= closes[f]))

for f in range(N):
    opt.add(Implies(friend_vars[0] == f, start_vars[0] >= 540 + T[0][locs[f]]))

for p in range(N - 1):
    for f in range(N):
        for g in range(N):
            opt.add(Implies(And(friend_vars[p] == f, friend_vars[p + 1] == g),
                            start_vars[p + 1] >= start_vars[p] + durs[f] + T[locs[f]][locs[g]]))

met_count = Sum([If(friend_vars[p] >= 0, 1, 0) for p in range(N)])
opt.maximize(met_count)
opt.check()
m = opt.model()

itinerary = []
itinerary.append("You start at Presidio at " + fmt_time(540) + ".")
current_time = 540
current_loc = 0

for p in range(N):
    fval = m.eval(friend_vars[p]).as_long()
    if fval == -1:
        break
    st = m.eval(start_vars[p]).as_long()
    dur = durs[fval]
    dest = locs[fval]
    if current_loc != dest:
        travel_time = T[current_loc][dest]
        arrive = current_time + travel_time
        itinerary.append(f"You travel to {location_names[dest]} in {travel_time} minutes and arrive at {fmt_time(arrive)}.")
        current_time = arrive
        current_loc = dest
    if current_time < st:
        itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt_time(st)}.")
        current_time = st
    end = st + dur
    itinerary.append(f"You meet {names[fval]} for {dur} minutes from {fmt_time(st)} to {fmt_time(end)}.")
    current_time = end

print(itinerary)

from z3 import *

def fmt_time(m):
    m = int(m)
    h = m // 60
    minute = m % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

T = [
    [0, 11, 12, 19, 11, 19, 15, 18, 18],
    [11, 0, 15, 13, 6, 10, 21, 8, 9],
    [11, 16, 0, 24, 16, 9, 10, 20, 23],
    [17, 12, 25, 0, 9, 21, 27, 11, 6],
    [10, 7, 18, 10, 0, 15, 19, 12, 11],
    [17, 10, 9, 19, 15, 0, 16, 11, 15],
    [16, 21, 11, 29, 21, 17, 0, 27, 28],
    [17, 8, 17, 10, 11, 11, 24, 0, 8],
    [17, 8, 22, 5, 9, 16, 27, 7, 0]
]

location_names = [
    "Presidio",
    "Pacific Heights",
    "Golden Gate Park",
    "Fisherman's Wharf",
    "Marina District",
    "Alamo Square",
    "Sunset District",
    "Nob Hill",
    "North Beach"
]

names = ["Kevin", "Michelle", "Emily", "Mark", "Barbara", "Laura", "Mary", "Helen"]
locs = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
opens = [435, 1200, 975, 1095, 1020, 1140, 1050, 660]
closes = [525, 1260, 1140, 1185, 1140, 1275, 1140, 735]
durs = [90, 15, 30, 75, 120, 75, 45, 45]

N = len(names)

opt = Optimize()
friend_vars = [Int(f"friend_{p}") for p in range(N)]
start_vars = [Int(f"start_{p}") for p in range(N)]

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(friend_vars[p] >= -1)
    opt.add(friend_vars[p] < N)
    opt.add(start_vars[p] >= 0)
    opt.add(start_vars[p] <= 2000)

for p in range(N - 1):
    opt.add(Implies(friend_vars[p] == -1, friend_vars[p + 1] == -1))

for f in range(N):
    opt.add(Sum([If(friend_vars[p] == f, 1, 0) for p in range(N)]) <= 1)

for p in range(N):
    for f in range(N):
        opt.add(Implies(friend_vars[p] == f, start_vars[p] >= opens[f]))
        opt.add(Implies(friend_vars[p] == f, start_vars[p] + durs[f] <= closes[f]))

for f in range(N):
    opt.add(Implies(friend_vars[0] == f, start_vars[0] >= 540 + T[0][locs[f]]))

for p in range(N - 1):
    for f in range(N):
        for g in range(N):
            opt.add(Implies(
                And(friend_vars[p] == f, friend_vars[p + 1] == g),
                start_vars[p + 1] >= start_vars[p] + durs[f] + T[locs[f]][locs[g]]
            ))

met_count = Sum([If(friend_vars[p] >= 0, 1, 0) for p in range(N)])
opt.maximize(met_count)
opt.check()
m = opt.model()

itinerary = []
itinerary.append("You start at Presidio at " + fmt_time(540) + ".")
current_time = 540
current_loc = 0

for p in range(N):
    fval = m.eval(friend_vars[p]).as_long()
    if fval == -1:
        break

    st = m.eval(start_vars[p]).as_long()
    dur = durs[fval]
    dest = locs[fval]

    if current_loc != dest:
        travel_time = T[current_loc][dest]
        arrive = current_time + travel_time
        itinerary.append(
            f"You travel to {location_names[dest]} in {travel_time} minutes and arrive at {fmt_time(arrive)}."
        )
        current_time = arrive
        current_loc = dest

    if current_time < st:
        itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt_time(st)}.")
        current_time = st

    end = st + dur
    itinerary.append(
        f"You meet {names[fval]} for {dur} minutes from {fmt_time(st)} to {fmt_time(end)}."
    )
    current_time = end

print(itinerary)

        RICHMOND: "Richmond District",
        FISHERMAN: "Fisherman's Wharf"
    }

    travel = {

        (FISHERMAN, EMBARCADERO): 8,
        (FISHERMAN, RICHMOND): 18

    friends = [

        {"name": "Sandra", "loc": RICHMOND, "open": 18 * 60 + 30, "close": 21 * 60 + 45, "dur": 120},
        {"name": "Jason", "loc": FISHERMAN, "open": 16 * 60, "close": 16 * 60 + 45, "dur": 30}

    start = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(n)]
    end = [Int(f"end_{i}") for i in range(n)]

    solver = Optimize()

    for i, f in enumerate(friends):
        solver.add(Implies(met[i], start[i] >= f["open"]))
        solver.add(Implies(met[i], end[i] == start[i] + f["dur"]))
        solver.add(Implies(met[i], end[i] <= f["close"]))

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            li = friends[i]["loc"]
            lj = friends[j]["loc"]
            tij = travel[(li, lj)]
            tji = travel[(lj, li)]
            solver.add(Implies(
                And(met[i], met[j]),
                Or(
                    end[i] + tij <= start[j],
                    end[j] + tji <= start[i]
                )
            ))

    start_time = 9 * 60

    for i, f in enumerate(friends):
        direct = start[i] >= start_time + travel[(BAYVIEW, f["loc"])]
        alternatives = [direct]
        for j, g in enumerate(friends):
            if i == j:

            alternatives.append(
                And(met[j], end[j] + travel[(g["loc"], f["loc"])] <= start[i])
            )
        solver.add(Implies(met[i], Or(*alternatives)))

    count = Sum([If(met[i], 1, 0) for i in range(n)])
    solver.maximize(count)
    solver.check()
    first_model = solver.model()
    max_count = sum(1 for i in range(n) if is_true(first_model.eval(met[i], model_completion=True)))

    solver.add(count == max_count)
    total_end = Sum([If(met[i], end[i], 0) for i in range(n)])
    solver.minimize(total_end)
    solver.check()
    model = solver.model()

    meetings = []
    for i, f in enumerate(friends):
        if is_true(model.eval(met[i], model_completion=True)):
            s = model.eval(start[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
            e = model.eval(end[i], model_completion=True).as_long()

    itinerary = [f"You start at Bayview at {fmt_time(start_time)}."]

def fmt(mins):
    mins = int(mins)
    h = mins // 60
    m = mins % 60

from z3 import *

def fmt(t):
    h = (t // 60) % 24
    m = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    hh = h % 12
    if hh == 0:
        hh = 12
    return f"{hh}:{m:02d}{suffix}"

B, NB, P, H, U = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
start_time = 9 * 60
travel = [
    [0, 21, 31, 19, 17],
    [22, 0, 17, 18, 7],
    [31, 18, 0, 15, 22],
    [18, 19, 15, 0, 17],
    [15, 10, 24, 18, 0]
]
loc_names = ["Bayview", "North Beach", "Presidio", "Haight-Ashbury", "Union Square"]

friends = [
    {"name": "Barbara", "loc": NB, "avail_start": 13*60+45, "avail_end": 20*60+15, "dur": 60},
    {"name": "Margaret", "loc": P, "avail_start": 10*60+15, "avail_end": 15*60+15, "dur": 30},
    {"name": "Kevin", "loc": H, "avail_start": 20*60, "avail_end": 20*60+45, "dur": 30},
    {"name": "Kimberly", "loc": U, "avail_start": 7*60+45, "avail_end": 16*60+45, "dur": 30},
]
n = len(friends)

s = Solver()

start = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(n)]
end = [Int(f"end_{i}") for i in range(n)]
pos = [Int(f"pos_{i}") for i in range(n)]

for i, f in enumerate(friends):
    s.add(start[i] >= f["avail_start"])
    s.add(start[i] >= start_time + travel[B][f["loc"]])
    s.add(end[i] == start[i] + f["dur"])
    s.add(end[i] <= f["avail_end"])
    s.add(pos[i] >= 0)
    s.add(pos[i] < n)

s.add(Distinct(pos))

for i in range(n):
    s.add(Implies(pos[i] == 0,
                  start[i] >= start_time + travel[B][friends[i]["loc"]]))
    for j in range(n):
        if i == j:
            continue
        s.add(Implies(pos[i] + 1 == pos[j],
                      start[j] >= end[i] + travel[friends[i]["loc"]][friends[j]["loc"]]))

if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    meetings = []
    for i, f in enumerate(friends):
        pi = m[pos[i]].as_long()
        si = m[start[i]].as_long()
        ei = m[end[i]].as_long()
        meetings.append({
            "name": f["name"],
            "loc": f["loc"],
            "pos": pi,
            "start": si,
            "end": ei
        })
    meetings.sort(key=lambda x: x["pos"])

    itinerary = []
    itinerary.append(f"You start at Bayview at {fmt(start_time)}.")
    curr_loc = B
    curr_time = start_time
    for mt in meetings:
        if curr_loc != mt["loc"]:
            t = travel[curr_loc][mt["loc"]]
            arrival = curr_time + t
            itinerary.append(
                f"You travel to {loc_names[mt['loc']]} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrival)}."
            )
            curr_time = arrival
            curr_loc = mt["loc"]
        if curr_time < mt["start"]:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(mt['start'])}.")
            curr_time = mt["start"]
        itinerary.append(
            f"You meet {mt['name']} from {fmt(mt['start'])} to {fmt(mt['end'])}."
        )
        curr_time = mt["end"]
    print(itinerary)
else:
    print([])

from z3 import *

friends = [
    {"name": "Rebecca", "loc": "Mission District", "open": 11*60+30, "close": 20*60+15, "min": 120},
    {"name": "Karen", "loc": "Bayview", "open": 12*60+45, "close": 15*60, "min": 120},
    {"name": "Carol", "loc": "Sunset District", "open": 10*60+15, "close": 11*60+45, "min": 30}
]

start_loc = "Union Square"
start_time = 9 * 60

travel = {
    ("Union Square", "Mission District"): 14,
    ("Union Square", "Bayview"): 15,
    ("Union Square", "Sunset District"): 26,
    ("Mission District", "Union Square"): 15,
    ("Mission District", "Bayview"): 15,
    ("Mission District", "Sunset District"): 24,
    ("Bayview", "Union Square"): 17,
    ("Bayview", "Mission District"): 13,
    ("Bayview", "Sunset District"): 23,
    ("Sunset District", "Union Square"): 30,
    ("Sunset District", "Mission District"): 24,
    ("Sunset District", "Bayview"): 22,
}
for loc in ["Union Square", "Mission District", "Bayview", "Sunset District"]:
    travel[(loc, loc)] = 0

n = len(friends)
met = [Bool(f"met_{i}") for i in range(n)]
start = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(n)]
before = {}
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i + 1, n):
        before[(i, j)] = Bool(f"before_{i}_{j}")


def before_ij(i, j):
    if i < j:
        return before[(i, j)]
    else:
        return Not(before[(j, i)])


def add_constraints(solver):
    for i in range(n):
        solver.add(start[i] >= 0)
        solver.add(start[i] <= 24 * 60)
        solver.add(Implies(met[i], start[i] >= friends[i]["open"]))
        solver.add(Implies(met[i], start[i] + friends[i]["min"] <= friends[i]["close"]))

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            cond = And(met[i], met[j])
            solver.add(Implies(
                cond,
                If(
                    before[(i, j)],
                    start[j] >= start[i] + friends[i]["min"] + travel[(friends[i]["loc"], friends[j]["loc"])],
                    start[i] >= start[j] + friends[j]["min"] + travel[(friends[j]["loc"], friends[i]["loc"])]
                )
            ))

    for i in range(n):
        no_before = []
        for j in range(n):
            if j == i:
                continue
            no_before.append(Or(Not(met[j]), Not(before_ij(j, i))))
        first_i = And(met[i], *no_before)
        solver.add(Implies(
            first_i,
            start[i] >= start_time + travel[(start_loc, friends[i]["loc"])]
        ))


count_expr = Sum([If(met[i], 1, 0) for i in range(n)])

opt = Optimize()
add_constraints(opt)
opt.maximize(count_expr)

if opt.check() == sat:
    m0 = opt.model()
    max_count = sum(1 for i in range(n) if is_true(m0.evaluate(met[i], model_completion=True)))

    opt2 = Optimize()
    add_constraints(opt2)
    opt2.add(count_expr == max_count)

    final_end = Int("final_end")
    opt2.add(final_end >= 0)
    for i in range(n):
        opt2.add(Implies(met[i], final_end >= start[i] + friends[i]["min"]))

    opt2.minimize(final_end * 100000 + Sum([If(met[i], start[i], 0) for i in range(n)]))

    if opt2.check() == sat:
        m = opt2.model()
        selected = []
        for i, f in enumerate(friends):
            if is_true(m.evaluate(met[i], model_completion=True)):
                st = m.evaluate(start[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
                selected.append({
                    "name": f["name"],
                    "loc": f["loc"],
                    "start": st,
                    "end": st + f["min"],
                    "duration": f["min"]
                })

        selected.sort(key=lambda x: x["start"])

        def fmt(mins):
            mins = int(mins) % (24 * 60)
            h = mins // 60
            mi = mins % 60
            suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
            h12 = h % 12
            if h12 == 0:
                h12 = 12
            return f"{h12}:{mi:02d}{suffix}"

        itinerary = []
        curr_time = start_time
        curr_loc = start_loc
        itinerary.append(f"You start at {start_loc} at {fmt(start_time)}.")

        for mtg in selected:
            t = travel[(curr_loc, mtg["loc"])]
            arrival = curr_time + t
            itinerary.append(f"You travel to {mtg['loc']} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrival)}.")
            if arrival < mtg["start"]:
                itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(mtg['start'])}.")
            itinerary.append(f"You meet {mtg['name']} for {mtg['duration']} minutes from {fmt(mtg['start'])} to {fmt(mtg['end'])}.")
            curr_time = mtg["end"]
            curr_loc = mtg["loc"]

        print(itinerary)
    else:
        print([])
else:
    print([])

from z3 import *

def fmt(t):
    t = t % (24*60)
    h = t // 60
    m = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    hh = h % 12
    if hh == 0:
        hh = 12
    return f"{hh}:{m:02d}{suffix}"

def main():
    friends = ["Emily", "Mark", "Deborah", "Margaret", "George", "Andrew", "Steven"]
    n = len(friends)
    loc_name = ["Alamo Square", "Russian Hill", "Presidio", "Chinatown", "Sunset District", "The Castro", "Embarcadero", "Golden Gate Park"]
    loc_index = {name:i for i,name in enumerate(loc_name)}
    friend_loc = [
       loc_index["Russian Hill"], # Emily
       loc_index["Presidio"],
       loc_index["Chinatown"],
       loc_index["Sunset District"],
       loc_index["The Castro"],
       loc_index["Embarcadero"],
       loc_index["Golden Gate Park"]
    ]
    avail_start = [12*60+15, 14*60+45, 7*60+30, 21*60+30, 7*60+30, 20*60+15, 11*60+15]
    avail_end = [14*60+15, 19*60+30, 15*60+30, 22*60+30, 14*60+15, 22*60, 21*60+15]
    duration = [105,60,45,60,60,75,105]
    travel = [
      [0,13,18,16,16,8,17,9],
      [15,0,14,9,23,21,8,21],
      [18,14,0,21,15,21,20,12],
      [17,7,19,0,29,22,5,23],
      [17,24,16,30,0,17,31,11],
      [8,18,20,20,17,0,22,11],
      [19,8,20,7,30,25,0,25],
      [10,19,11,23,10,13,25,0]
    ]
    START = 9*60
    met = [Bool(f"met_{i}") for i in range(n)]
    start = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(n)]
    end = [Int(f"end_{i}") for i in range(n)]
    pos = [Int(f"pos_{i}") for i in range(n)]
    count = Sum([If(met[i], 1, 0) for i in range(n)])

    def add_constraints(s):
        for i in range(n):
            s.add(Implies(met[i], start[i] >= START))
            s.add(Implies(met[i], start[i] >= avail_start[i]))
            s.add(Implies(met[i], end[i] <= avail_end[i]))
            s.add(Implies(met[i], end[i] == start[i] + duration[i]))
            s.add(Implies(met[i], pos[i] >= 0))
            s.add(Implies(met[i], pos[i] < count))
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i+1,n):
                s.add(Implies(And(met[i], met[j]), pos[i] != pos[j]))
        for i in range(n):
            s.add(Implies(And(met[i], pos[i] == 0), start[i] >= START + travel[0][friend_loc[i]]))
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                if i == j: continue
                s.add(Implies(And(met[i], met[j], pos[i] + 1 == pos[j]),
                              start[j] >= end[i] + travel[friend_loc[i]][friend_loc[j]]))

    opt = Optimize()
    add_constraints(opt)
    opt.maximize(count)
    if opt.check() != sat:
        print([])
        return
    m1 = opt.model()
    maxc = m1.eval(count).as_long()

    opt2 = Optimize()
    add_constraints(opt2)
    opt2.add(count == maxc)
    total_end = Sum([If(met[i], end[i], 0) for i in range(n)])
    opt2.minimize(total_end)
    if opt2.check() != sat:
        print([])
        return
    m = opt2.model()

    meetings = []
    for i in range(n):
        if is_true(m.eval(met[i], model_completion=True)):
            p = m.eval(pos[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
            st = m.eval(start[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
            en = m.eval(end[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
            meetings.append((p, i, st, en))
    meetings.sort()

    itinerary = []
    itinerary.append(f"You start at Alamo Square at {fmt(START)}.")
    current_time = START
    current_loc = loc_index["Alamo Square"]
    for p, i, st, en in meetings:
        dest = friend_loc[i]
        travel_min = travel[current_loc][dest]
        arrival = current_time + travel_min
        itinerary.append(f"You travel to {loc_name[dest]} in {travel_min} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrival)}.")
        if st > arrival:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(st)}.")
        itinerary.append(f"You meet {friends[i]} from {fmt(st)} to {fmt(en)}.")
        current_time = en
        current_loc = dest

    print(itinerary)

from z3 import *

def fmt(t):
    t = t % (24 * 60)
    h = t // 60
    m = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    hh = h % 12
    if hh == 0:
        hh = 12
    return f"{hh}:{m:02d}{suffix}"

def main():
    friends = ["Emily", "Mark", "Deborah", "Margaret", "George", "Andrew", "Steven"]
    n = len(friends)

    loc_name = [
        "Alamo Square",
        "Russian Hill",
        "Presidio",
        "Chinatown",
        "Sunset District",
        "The Castro",
        "Embarcadero",
        "Golden Gate Park"
    ]
    loc_index = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(loc_name)}

    friend_loc = [
        loc_index["Russian Hill"],
        loc_index["Presidio"],
        loc_index["Chinatown"],
        loc_index["Sunset District"],
        loc_index["The Castro"],
        loc_index["Embarcadero"],
        loc_index["Golden Gate Park"]
    ]

    avail_start = [
        12 * 60 + 15,
        14 * 60 + 45,
        7 * 60 + 30,
        21 * 60 + 30,
        7 * 60 + 30,
        20 * 60 + 15,
        11 * 60 + 15
    ]

    avail_end = [
        14 * 60 + 15,
        19 * 60 + 30,
        15 * 60 + 30,
        22 * 60 + 30,
        14 * 60 + 15,
        22 * 60,
        21 * 60 + 15
    ]

    duration = [105, 60, 45, 60, 60, 75, 105]

    travel = [
        [0, 13, 18, 16, 16, 8, 17, 9],
        [15, 0, 14, 9, 23, 21, 8, 21],
        [18, 14, 0, 21, 15, 21, 20, 12],
        [17, 7, 19, 0, 29, 22, 5, 23],
        [17, 24, 16, 30, 0, 17, 31, 11],
        [8, 18, 20, 20, 17, 0, 22, 11],
        [19, 8, 20, 7, 30, 25, 0, 25],
        [10, 19, 11, 23, 10, 13, 25, 0]
    ]

    START = 9 * 60

    met = [Bool(f"met_{i}") for i in range(n)]
    start = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(n)]
    end = [Int(f"end_{i}") for i in range(n)]
    pos = [Int(f"pos_{i}") for i in range(n)]

    count = Sum([If(met[i], 1, 0) for i in range(n)])

    def add_constraints(s):
        for i in range(n):
            s.add(Implies(met[i], start[i] >= START))
            s.add(Implies(met[i], start[i] >= avail_start[i]))
            s.add(Implies(met[i], end[i] <= avail_end[i]))
            s.add(Implies(met[i], end[i] == start[i] + duration[i]))
            s.add(Implies(met[i], pos[i] >= 0))
            s.add(Implies(met[i], pos[i] < count))

        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                s.add(Implies(And(met[i], met[j]), pos[i] != pos[j]))

        for i in range(n):
            s.add(Implies(
                And(met[i], pos[i] == 0),
                start[i] >= START + travel[0][friend_loc[i]]
            ))

        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                if i == j:
                    continue
                s.add(Implies(
                    And(met[i], met[j], pos[i] + 1 == pos[j]),
                    start[j] >= end[i] + travel[friend_loc[i]][friend_loc[j]]
                ))

    opt = Optimize()
    add_constraints(opt)
    opt.maximize(count)

    if opt.check() != sat:
        print([])
        return

    m1 = opt.model()
    maxc = m1.eval(count, model_completion=True).as_long()

    opt2 = Optimize()
    add_constraints(opt2)
    opt2.add(count == maxc)

    total_end = Sum([If(met[i], end[i], 0) for i in range(n)])
    opt2.minimize(total_end)

    if opt2.check() != sat:
        print([])
        return

    m = opt2.model()

    meetings = []
    for i in range(n):
        if is_true(m.eval(met[i], model_completion=True)):
            p = m.eval(pos[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
            st = m.eval(start[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
            en = m.eval(end[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
            meetings.append((p, i, st, en))

    meetings.sort()

    itinerary = []
    itinerary.append(f"You start at Alamo Square at {fmt(START)}.")

    current_time = START
    current_loc = loc_index["Alamo Square"]

    for p, i, st, en in meetings:
        dest = friend_loc[i]
        travel_min = travel[current_loc][dest]
        arrival = current_time + travel_min

        itinerary.append(
            f"You travel to {loc_name[dest]} in {travel_min} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrival)}."
        )

        if st > arrival:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(st)}.")

        itinerary.append(
            f"You meet {friends[i]} from {fmt(st)} to {fmt(en)}."
        )

        current_time = en
        current_loc = dest

    print(itinerary)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from z3 import *

# Data
names = ["Helen", "Steven", "Deborah", "Matthew", "Joseph", "Ronald", "Robert", "Rebecca", "Elizabeth"]
locations = ["Golden Gate Park", "The Castro", "Bayview", "Marina District", "Union Square", "Sunset District", "Alamo Square", "Financial District", "Mission District"]
avail_start = [570, 1215, 510, 555, 855, 960, 1110, 885, 1110]
avail_end = [735, 1320, 720, 855, 1125, 1245, 1275, 975, 1260]
min_dur = [45, 105, 30, 45, 120, 60, 120, 30, 120]

START_TIME = 9*60  # 540
START_LOC = "Pacific Heights"

start_to = [15, 16, 22, 6, 12, 21, 10, 13, 15]

travel_matrix = [
    [0, 13, 23, 16, 22, 10, 9, 26, 17],  # Helen
    [11, 0, 19, 21, 19, 17, 8, 21, 7],   # Steven
    [22, 19, 0, 27, 18, 23, 16, 19, 13], # Deborah
    [18, 22, 27, 0, 16, 19, 15, 17, 20], # Matthew
    [22, 17, 15, 18, 0, 27, 15, 9, 14],  # Joseph
    [11, 17, 22, 21, 30, 0, 17, 30, 25], # Ronald
    [9, 8, 16, 15, 14, 16, 0, 17, 10],   # Robert
    [23, 20, 19, 15, 9, 30, 17, 0, 17],  # Rebecca
    [17, 7, 14, 19, 15, 24, 11, 15, 0]   # Elizabeth
]

def select_by_idx(var, values):
    expr = values[-1]
    for i in range(len(values)-2, -1, -1):
        expr = If(var == i, values[i], expr)
    return expr

def travel_expr(a, b):
    def row_expr(row):
        e = row[-1]
        for j in range(len(row)-2, -1, -1):
            e = If(b == j, row[j], e)
        return e
    e = row_expr(travel_matrix[-1])
    for i in range(len(travel_matrix)-2, -1, -1):
        e = If(a == i, row_expr(travel_matrix[i]), e)
    return e

N = len(names)
meet = [Bool(f"meet_{i}") for i in range(N)]
fid = [Int(f"fid_{i}") for i in range(N)]
start = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(N)]

opt = Optimize()
for i in range(N):
    opt.add(fid[i] >= 0, fid[i] < N)
    opt.add(start[i] >= 0, start[i] <= 24*60)

for i in range(N):
    m = meet[i]
    f = fid[i]
    st = start[i]
    dur = select_by_idx(f, min_dur)
    av_s = select_by_idx(f, avail_start)
    av_e = select_by_idx(f, avail_end)
    opt.add(Implies(m, st >= av_s))
    opt.add(Implies(m, st + dur <= av_e))
    if i == 0:
        travel = select_by_idx(f, start_to)
        opt.add(Implies(m, st >= START_TIME + travel))
    else:
        opt.add(Implies(m, meet[i-1]))
        prev_dur = select_by_idx(fid[i-1], min_dur)
        travel = travel_expr(fid[i-1], f)
        opt.add(Implies(m, st >= start[i-1] + prev_dur + travel))
        for j in range(i):
            opt.add(Implies(m, f != fid[j]))

opt.maximize(Sum([If(meet[i], 1, 0) for i in range(N)]))

def fmt_time(t):
    t = int(t) % (24*60)
    h = t // 60
    mi = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{mi:02d}{suffix}"

if opt.check() == sat:
    model = opt.model()
    result = ["You start at Pacific Heights at 9:00AM."]
    prev_time = START_TIME
    prev_fid = None
    for i in range(N):
        if is_true(model.eval(meet[i], model_completion=True)):
            cfid = model.eval(fid[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
            cstart = model.eval(start[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
            dur = min_dur[cfid]
            cend = cstart + dur
            loc = locations[cfid]
            if prev_fid is None:
                travel = start_to[cfid]
                arrival = START_TIME + travel
            else:
                travel = travel_matrix[prev_fid][cfid]
                arrival = prev_time + travel
            result.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {travel} minutes and arrive at {fmt_time(arrival)}.")
            if cstart > arrival:
                result.append(f"You wait until {fmt_time(cstart)}.")
            result.append(f"You meet {names[cfid]} for {dur} minutes from {fmt_time(cstart)} to {fmt_time(cend)}.")
            prev_time = cend
            prev_fid = cfid
        else:
            break
    print(result)
else:
    print([])

    expr = values[-1]
    for i in range(len(values) - 2, -1, -1):
        expr = If(var == i, values[i], expr)

def fmt_time(t):
    h = t // 60
    m = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{m:02d}{suffix}"

def build_itinerary(seq, times):
    result = [f"You start at {START_LOC} at {fmt_time(START_TIME)}."]
    cur_loc = START_LOC
    cur_time = START_TIME

    for name, s in zip(seq, times):
        dest = location[name]
        dur = min_duration[name]
        e = s + dur

        if dest != cur_loc:
            ttime = travel[(cur_loc, dest)]
            arrival = cur_time + ttime
            result.append(f"You travel to {dest} in {ttime} minutes and arrive at {fmt_time(arrival)}.")
            cur_time = arrival

        if cur_time < s:
            result.append(f"You wait until {fmt_time(s)}.")
            cur_time = s

        result.append(f"You meet {name} for {dur} minutes from {fmt_time(s)} to {fmt_time(e)}.")
        cur_loc = dest
        cur_time = e

    return result

itinerary = build_itinerary(best_seq, best_times)

from z3 import *

names = ["Stephanie", "Karen", "Brian", "Rebecca", "Joseph", "Steven"]
locs = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
loc_names = [
    "Financial District",
    "Golden Gate Park",
    "Chinatown",
    "Union Square",
    "Fisherman's Wharf",
    "Pacific Heights",
    "North Beach"
]

avail_start = [11 * 60, 13 * 60 + 45, 15 * 60, 8 * 60, 8 * 60 + 15, 14 * 60 + 30]
avail_end = [15 * 60, 16 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60 + 15, 11 * 60 + 15, 9 * 60 + 30, 20 * 60 + 45]
min_dur = [105, 15, 30, 30, 60, 120]

travel = [
    [0, 23, 5, 9, 10, 13, 7],
    [26, 0, 23, 22, 24, 16, 24],
    [5, 23, 0, 7, 8, 10, 3],
    [9, 22, 7, 0, 15, 15, 10],
    [11, 25, 12, 13, 0, 12, 6],
    [13, 15, 11, 12, 13, 0, 9],
    [8, 22, 6, 7, 5, 8, 0]
]

N = len(names)
M = N
SENT = N
START_TIME = 9 * 60
START_LOC = 0

p = [Int(f"p_{k}") for k in range(M)]
start = [Int(f"start_{k}") for k in range(M)]

opt = Optimize()

for k in range(M):
    opt.add(p[k] >= 0, p[k] <= SENT)

for i in range(N):
    opt.add(Sum([If(p[k] == i, 1, 0) for k in range(M)]) <= 1)

for k in range(M - 1):
    opt.add(Implies(p[k] == SENT, p[k + 1] == SENT))

for k in range(M):
    for i in range(N):
        opt.add(Implies(p[k] == i,
                        And(start[k] >= avail_start[i],
                            start[k] + min_dur[i] <= avail_end[i])))

for i in range(N):
    opt.add(Implies(p[0] == i,
                    start[0] >= START_TIME + travel[START_LOC][locs[i]]))

for k in range(1, M):
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            opt.add(Implies(And(p[k - 1] == i, p[k] == j),
                            start[k] >= start[k - 1] + min_dur[i] + travel[locs[i]][locs[j]]))

count = Sum([If(p[k] != SENT, 1, 0) for k in range(M)])
opt.maximize(count)
opt.minimize(Sum([If(p[k] != SENT, start[k], 0) for k in range(M)]))

check = opt.check()
if check != sat:
    raise RuntimeError

model = opt.model()

def fmt_time(total_minutes):
    total_minutes = int(total_minutes)
    hour = (total_minutes // 60) % 24
    minute = total_minutes % 60
    suffix = "AM" if hour < 12 else "PM"
    hour12 = hour % 12
    if hour12 == 0:
        hour12 = 12
    return f"{hour12}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

itinerary = ["You start at Financial District at 9:00AM."]
current_loc = START_LOC
current_time = START_TIME

for k in range(M):
    i = model.eval(p[k]).as_long()
    if i == SENT:
        break

    s = model.eval(start[k]).as_long()
    travel_time = travel[current_loc][locs[i]]
    arrive = current_time + travel_time

    itinerary.append(
        f"You travel to {loc_names[locs[i]]} in {travel_time} minutes and arrive at {fmt_time(arrive)}."
    )

    if s > arrive:
        itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt_time(s)}.")

    e = s + min_dur[i]
    itinerary.append(
        f"You meet {names[i]} for {min_dur[i]} minutes from {fmt_time(s)} to {fmt_time(e)}."
    )

    current_loc = locs[i]
    current_time = e

print(itinerary)

    "Alamo Square": {"Sunset District": 16, "North Beach": 15, "Union Square": 14},
}

start_time = 9 * 60
start_loc = "Sunset District"

friends = [

    {"name": "Brian", "loc": "Alamo Square", "avail_start": 16 * 60, "avail_end": 17 * 60 + 30, "dur": 75},
]

n = len(friends)
met = [Bool(f"met_{i}") for i in range(n)]
st = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(n)]
pos = [Int(f"pos_{i}") for i in range(n)]

opt = Optimize()

for i, f in enumerate(friends):
    opt.add(st[i] >= 0, st[i] <= 24 * 60)
    opt.add(pos[i] >= 0, pos[i] < n)
    opt.add(Implies(met[i], st[i] >= f["avail_start"]))
    opt.add(Implies(met[i], st[i] + f["dur"] <= f["avail_end"]))

opt.add(Distinct(pos))

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if i == j:
            continue
        travel = travel_times[friends[i]["loc"]][friends[j]["loc"]]
        opt.add(Implies(And(met[i], met[j], pos[i] < pos[j]),
                        st[j] >= st[i] + friends[i]["dur"] + travel))

for i, f in enumerate(friends):
    conds = [met[i]]
    for j in range(n):
        if j != i:
            conds.append(Or(Not(met[j]), pos[j] > pos[i]))
    travel = travel_times[start_loc][f["loc"]]
    opt.add(Implies(And(*conds), st[i] >= start_time + travel))

opt.maximize(Sum([If(met[i], 1, 0) for i in range(n)]))

if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    meetings = []
    for i, f in enumerate(friends):
        if is_true(m.eval(met[i], model_completion=True)):

    "Sunset District": {"North Beach": 29, "Union Square": 30, "Alamo Square": 17},
    "North Beach": {"Sunset District": 27, "Union Square": 7, "Alamo Square": 16},
    "Union Square": {"Sunset District": 26, "North Beach": 10, "Alamo Square": 15},
    "Alamo Square": {"Sunset District": 16, "North Beach": 15, "Union Square": 14},
}

start_time = 9 * 60
start_loc = "Sunset District"

friends = [
    {"name": "Sarah", "loc": "North Beach", "avail_start": 16 * 60, "avail_end": 18 * 60 + 15, "dur": 60},
    {"name": "Jeffrey", "loc": "Union Square", "avail_start": 15 * 60, "avail_end": 22 * 60, "dur": 75},
    {"name": "Brian", "loc": "Alamo Square", "avail_start": 16 * 60, "avail_end": 17 * 60 + 30, "dur": 75},
]

n = len(friends)
met = [Bool(f"met_{i}") for i in range(n)]
st = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(n)]
pos = [Int(f"pos_{i}") for i in range(n)]

opt = Optimize()

for i, f in enumerate(friends):
    opt.add(st[i] >= 0, st[i] <= 24 * 60)
    opt.add(pos[i] >= 0, pos[i] < n)
    opt.add(Implies(met[i], st[i] >= f["avail_start"]))
    opt.add(Implies(met[i], st[i] + f["dur"] <= f["avail_end"]))

opt.add(Distinct(pos))

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if i == j:
            continue
        travel = travel_times[friends[i]["loc"]][friends[j]["loc"]]
        opt.add(Implies(And(met[i], met[j], pos[i] < pos[j]),
                        st[j] >= st[i] + friends[i]["dur"] + travel))

for i, f in enumerate(friends):
    conds = [met[i]]
    for j in range(n):
        if j != i:
            conds.append(Or(Not(met[j]), pos[j] > pos[i]))
    travel = travel_times[start_loc][f["loc"]]
    opt.add(Implies(And(*conds), st[i] >= start_time + travel))

opt.maximize(Sum([If(met[i], 1, 0) for i in range(n)]))

if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    meetings = []
    for i, f in enumerate(friends):
        if is_true(m.eval(met[i], model_completion=True)):
            start_val = m.eval(st[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
            pos_val = m.eval(pos[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
            meetings.append((pos_val, i, start_val))
    meetings.sort()

    itinerary = [f"You start at {start_loc} at {fmt_time(start_time)}."]
    cur_loc = start_loc
    cur_time = start_time

    for _, i, meeting_start in meetings:
        f = friends[i]
        travel = travel_times[cur_loc][f["loc"]]
        arrival = cur_time + travel
        itinerary.append(f"You travel to {f['loc']} in {travel} minutes and arrive at {fmt_time(arrival)}.")
        if arrival < meeting_start:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt_time(meeting_start)}.")
        meeting_end = meeting_start + f["dur"]
        itinerary.append(f"You meet {f['name']} for {f['dur']} minutes from {fmt_time(meeting_start)} to {fmt_time(meeting_end)}.")
        cur_time = meeting_end
        cur_loc = f["loc"]

    print(itinerary)
else:
    print([])

]
start_loc = "Sunset District"
start_time = 9*60
travel = {
    "Sunset District": {"Alamo Square": 17, "Russian Hill": 24, "Golden Gate Park": 11, "Mission District": 24},
    "Alamo Square": {"Sunset District": 16, "Russian Hill": 13, "Golden Gate Park": 9, "Mission District": 10},
    "Russian Hill": {"Sunset District": 23, "Alamo Square": 15, "Golden Gate Park": 21, "Mission District": 16},
    "Golden Gate Park": {"Sunset District": 10, "Alamo Square": 10, "Russian Hill": 19, "Mission District": 17},
    "Mission District": {"Sunset District": 24, "Alamo Square": 11, "Russian Hill": 15, "Golden Gate Park": 17}
}

def fmt(t):
    t = int(t)
    h = (t // 60) % 24
    m = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{m:02d}{suffix}"

n = len(friends)
for target in range(n, -1, -1):
    solver = Solver()
    meet = [Bool(f"meet_{i}") for i in range(n)]
    s = [Int(f"s_{i}") for i in range(n)]
    e = [Int(f"e_{i}") for i in range(n)]
    p = [Int(f"p_{i}") for i in range(n)]

    solver.add(Sum([If(meet[i], 1, 0) for i in range(n)]) == target)

    for i in range(n):
        name, loc, avail_start, avail_end, dur = friends[i]
        solver.add(Implies(Not(meet[i]), And(p[i] == -1, s[i] == 0, e[i] == 0)))
        solver.add(Implies(meet[i], And(p[i] >= 0, p[i] < n)))
        solver.add(Implies(meet[i], And(s[i] >= avail_start, e[i] == s[i] + dur, e[i] <= avail_end)))
        solver.add(Implies(And(meet[i], p[i] == 0), s[i] >= start_time + travel[start_loc][loc]))

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if i == j:

            solver.add(Implies(And(meet[i], meet[j]), p[i] != p[j]))
            loc_i = friends[i][1]
            loc_j = friends[j][1]
            solver.add(Implies(And(meet[i], meet[j], p[j] == p[i] + 1),
                               s[j] >= e[i] + travel[loc_i][loc_j]))

    for r in range(1, n):
        has_r = Or([And(meet[i], p[i] == r) for i in range(n)])
        has_prev = Or([And(meet[i], p[i] == r - 1) for i in range(n)])
        solver.add(Implies(has_r, has_prev))

    if solver.check() == sat:
        model = solver.model()
        break

selected = []
for i in range(n):
    if is_true(model.eval(meet[i], model_completion=True)):
        start = model.eval(s[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
        end = model.eval(e[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
        pos = model.eval(p[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
        selected.append((pos, i, start, end))
selected.sort()

itinerary = []
itinerary.append(f"You start at {start_loc} at {fmt(start_time)}.")
current_loc = start_loc
current_time = start_time

for pos, i, start, end in selected:
    name, loc, avail_start, avail_end, dur = friends[i]

from z3 import *

N = 10
names = [...]
loc_names = [...]
T = [...]
f_loc = [None, 1,2,...]
min_dur = [...]
av_start = [...]
av_end = [...]

START = 9*60
s = Optimize()

id = [Int(f"id_{k}") for k in range(N+1)]
start = [None] + [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(1,N+1)]
met = [None] + [Bool(f"met_{i}") for i in range(1,N+1)]

s.add(id[0] == 0)
for k in range(N+1): # id[0] too
  s.add(id[k] >= 0, id[k] <= N)
for i in range(1,N+1):
  s.add(met[i] == Or([id[k] == i for k in range(1,N+1)]))
  s.add(Sum([If(id[k] == i, 1, 0) for k in range(1,N+1)]) <= 1)
  s.add(Implies(met[i], start[i] >= av_start[i]))
  s.add(Implies(met[i], start[i] + min_dur[i] <= av_end[i]))

for k in range(1,N):
  s.add(Implies(id[k] == 0, id[k+1] == 0))

# first transition
for i in range(1,N+1):
    s.add(Implies(id[1] == i, start[i] >= START + T[0][f_loc[i]]))

# consecutive transitions
for k in range(1,N):
    for j in range(1,N+1):
        for i in range(1,N+1):
            s.add(Implies(And(id[k] == j, id[k+1] == i),
                  start[i] >= start[j] + min_dur[j] + T[f_loc[j]][f_loc[i]]))

# maximize
s.maximize(Sum([If(met[i], 1, 0) for i in range(1,N+1)]))

      suf = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
      hh = h % 12
      if hh == 0: hh = 12
      return f"{hh}:{mm:02d}{suf}"
   seq = []
   for k in range(1,N+1):
       v = m.evaluate(id[k]).as_long()
       if v != 0:
           seq.append(v)
   out = [f"You start at {loc_names[0]} at {fmt(START)}."]
   cur_loc = 0
   cur_time = START
   for i in seq:
       st = m.evaluate(start[i]).as_long()
       en = st + min_dur[i]
       dest = f_loc[i]
       if dest != cur_loc:
           tt = T[cur_loc][dest]
           arr = cur_time + tt
           out.append(f"You travel to {loc_names[dest]} in {tt} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arr)}.")
       else:
           arr = cur_time

from z3 import *

def fmt_time(t):
    t = int(t)
    h24 = (t // 60) % 24
    minute = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h24 < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h24 % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

solver = Solver()

# Times are minutes after midnight.
start_time = Int('start_time')
travel_start = Int('travel_start')
arrival = Int('arrival')
meet_start = Int('meet_start')
meet_end = Int('meet_end')
meet_daniel = Bool('meet_daniel')

# Start at Russian Hill at 9:00AM.
solver.add(start_time == 9 * 60)

# Travel from Russian Hill to Richmond District takes 14 minutes.
solver.add(travel_start >= start_time)
solver.add(arrival == travel_start + 14)
solver.add(meet_start == arrival)

# Daniel is available from 7:00PM to 8:15PM.
solver.add(meet_start >= 19 * 60)
solver.add(meet_end <= 20 * 60 + 15)

# Meet Daniel for at least 75 minutes.
solver.add(meet_daniel)
solver.add(meet_end - meet_start >= 75)

# Arrive exactly when the meeting starts.
solver.add(travel_start == meet_start - 14)

if solver.check() == sat:
    m = solver.model()
    st = int(m.eval(start_time).as_long())
    tr = int(m.eval(travel_start).as_long())
    ar = int(m.eval(arrival).as_long())
    ms = int(m.eval(meet_start).as_long())
    me = int(m.eval(meet_end).as_long())
    duration = me - ms

    itinerary = []
    itinerary.append(f"You start at Russian Hill at {fmt_time(st)}.")
    if tr > st:
        itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt_time(tr)}.")
    itinerary.append(f"You travel to Richmond District in 14 minutes and arrive at {fmt_time(ar)}.")
    if is_true(m.eval(meet_daniel)):
        itinerary.append(f"You meet Daniel for {duration} minutes from {fmt_time(ms)} to {fmt_time(me)}.")

    print(itinerary)
else:
    print([])

    h = (mins // 60) % 24
    m = mins % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"

    if hh == 0:

travel = [

]

solver = Solver()

loc = [Int(f"loc_{i}") for i in range(N)]
start = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(N)]

    solver.add(loc[i] >= 0, loc[i] < N)
    for f in range(N):
        solver.add(Implies(loc[i] == f, start[i] >= opens[f]))
        solver.add(Implies(loc[i] == f, start[i] + 90 <= closes[f]))

for f in range(N):
    solver.add(Implies(loc[0] == f, start[0] >= 540 + start_travel[f]))

for i in range(N - 1):
    for f in range(N):
        for g in range(N):
            if f != g:
                solver.add(Implies(
                    And(loc[i] == f, loc[i + 1] == g),
                    start[i + 1] >= start[i] + 90 + travel[f][g]
                ))

start_vals = [model[start[i]].as_long() for i in range(N)]

    if h12 == 0:

    return f"{h12}:{m:02d}{suffix}"

prev_end = 540

for i in range(N):

    if i == 0:

    else:

    arrival = prev_end + ttime
    itinerary.append(

    )

    if s > arrival:

    end = s + 90
    itinerary.append(

    )

    prev_end = end

def fmt(t):

    m = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"

    ("Alamo Square", "Sunset District"): 16,

    ("Alamo Square", "Presidio"): 18,

    ("Russian Hill", "Sunset District"): 23,

    ("Presidio", "Financial District"): 23,
    ("Financial District", "Sunset District"): 31,
    ("Financial District", "Alamo Square"): 17,
    ("Financial District", "Russian Hill"): 10,
    ("Financial District", "Presidio"): 22,
}

friends = [
    ("Kimberly", "Russian Hill", 30, 8 * 60 + 45, 12 * 60 + 30),
    ("Kevin", "Alamo Square", 75, 8 * 60 + 15, 21 * 60 + 30),
    ("Joseph", "Presidio", 45, 18 * 60 + 30, 19 * 60 + 15),
    ("Thomas", "Financial District", 45, 19 * 60, 21 * 60 + 45),
]

n = len(friends)
start_time = 9 * 60
start_loc = "Sunset District"

met = [Bool(f"met_{i}") for i in range(n)]
starts = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(n)]

opt = Optimize()

for i, (name, loc, dur, avail_start, avail_end) in enumerate(friends):
    opt.add(Implies(met[i], starts[i] >= avail_start))
    opt.add(Implies(met[i], starts[i] + dur <= avail_end))
    opt.add(Implies(met[i], starts[i] >= start_time + travel[(start_loc, loc)]))

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i + 1, n):
        name_i, loc_i, dur_i, _, _ = friends[i]
        name_j, loc_j, dur_j, _, _ = friends[j]
        before = Bool(f"before_{i}_{j}")
        opt.add(
            Implies(
                And(met[i], met[j]),
                Or(
                    And(
                        before,
                        starts[j] >= starts[i] + dur_i + travel[(loc_i, loc_j)]
                    ),
                    And(
                        Not(before),
                        starts[i] >= starts[j] + dur_j + travel[(loc_j, loc_i)]
                    )
                )
            )
        )

count = sum([If(met[i], 1, 0) for i in range(n)])
sum_starts = sum([If(met[i], starts[i], 0) for i in range(n)])
opt.maximize(count * 100000 - sum_starts)

if opt.check() == sat:
    model = opt.model()
    active = []
    for i in range(n):
        if is_true(model.eval(met[i], model_completion=True)):
            st = model[starts[i]].as_long()
            active.append((st, i))
    active.sort()

    itinerary = []
    current_time = start_time
    current_loc = start_loc
    itinerary.append(f"You start at {current_loc} at {fmt(current_time)}.")

        arrival = current_time + t_time
        itinerary.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {t_time} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrival)}.")
        if st > arrival:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(st)}.")
        end = st + dur
        itinerary.append(f"You meet {name} from {fmt(st)} to {fmt(end)}.")
        current_time = end
        current_loc = loc

    print(itinerary)

from z3 import *

travel = {...}
friends = [...]
n = len(friends)
met = [Bool(f"met_{i}") for i in range(n)]
start = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(n)]

opt = Optimize()
for i in range(n):
    name, loc, av_s, av_e, dur = friends[i]
    opt.add(Implies(met[i], start[i] >= av_s))
    opt.add(Implies(met[i], start[i] + dur <= av_e))
    opt.add(Implies(met[i], start[i] >= 540 + travel["Bayview"][loc]))

for i in range(n):
    name_i, loc_i, _, _, dur_i = friends[i]
    for j in range(i+1,n):
        name_j, loc_j, _, _, dur_j = friends[j]
        opt.add(Or(
            Not(met[i]),
            Not(met[j]),
            start[i] + dur_i + travel[loc_i][loc_j] <= start[j],
            start[j] + dur_j + travel[loc_j][loc_i] <= start[i]
        ))

opt.maximize(Sum([If(met[i], 1, 0) for i in range(n)]))
if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    meetings = []
    for i in range(n):
        if is_true(m.eval(met[i], model_completion=True)):
            s = m.eval(start[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
            meetings.append((s, i))
    meetings.sort()
    def fmt(t):
        t = int(t)
        h = t // 60
        minute = t % 60
        suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
        h12 = h % 12
        if h12 == 0:
            h12 = 12
        return f"{h12}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"
    itinerary = []
    itinerary.append("You start at Bayview at 9:00AM.")
    cur_time = 540
    cur_loc = "Bayview"
    for s, i in meetings:
        name, loc, _, _, dur = friends[i]
        tt = travel[cur_loc][loc]
        arrival = cur_time + tt
        itinerary.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {tt} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrival)}.")
        if arrival < s:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(s)}.")
        end = s + dur
        itinerary.append(f"You meet {name} for {dur} minutes from {fmt(s)} to {fmt(end)}.")
        cur_time = end
        cur_loc = loc
    print(itinerary)
else:
    print([])

def solve_for(selected):
    s=Solver()
    starts={}
    pos={}
    for idx in selected:
        starts[idx]=Int(f'start_{idx}')
        pos[idx]=Int(f'pos_{idx}')
        f=friends[idx]
        s.add(starts[idx] >= f['start'])
        s.add(starts[idx] + f['min'] <= f['end'])
        s.add(pos[idx]>=0, pos[idx]<m)
    s.add(Distinct([pos[i] for i in selected]))
    for idx in selected:
        loc=friends[idx]['loc']
        s.add(Implies(pos[idx]==0, starts[idx] >= 540 + travel["Richmond District"][loc]))
    for i in selected:
        for j in selected:
            if i==j: continue
            loc_i=friends[i]['loc']; loc_j=friends[j]['loc']
            s.add(Implies(pos[j]==pos[i]+1,
                          starts[j] >= starts[i] + friends[i]['min'] + travel[loc_i][loc_j]))
    if s.check()==sat:
        model=s.model()
        # sort selected by pos eval
        def pval(i): return model.eval(pos[i], model_completion=True).as_long()
        order=sorted(selected, key=pval)
        starts_val={i: model.eval(starts[i], model_completion=True).as_long() for i in selected}
        return order, starts_val
    else return None

def fmt(t):
    t = int(t)
    h = t // 60
    m = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{m:02d}{suffix}"

def loc_name(l):

end_r = Int('end_r')

from z3 import *

def fmt(t):
    t = int(t)
    h = t // 60
    m = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{m:02d}{suffix}"

def loc_name(l):
    return {'N': 'North Beach', 'M': 'Mission District', 'C': 'The Castro'}[l]

def travel_time(a, b):
    if a == b:
        return 0
    return {
        ('N', 'M'): 18,
        ('N', 'C'): 22,
        ('M', 'N'): 17,
        ('M', 'C'): 7,
        ('C', 'N'): 20,
        ('C', 'M'): 7,
    }[(a, b)]

arrival_north_beach = 9 * 60
james_open = 12 * 60 + 45
james_close = 14 * 60
robert_open = 12 * 60 + 45
robert_close = 15 * 60 + 15
james_min = 75
robert_min = 30

meet_j = Bool('meet_j')
meet_r = Bool('meet_r')
start_j = Int('start_j')
end_j = Int('end_j')
start_r = Int('start_r')
end_r = Int('end_r')
j_before_r = Bool('j_before_r')

opt = Optimize()

opt.add(Implies(meet_j, And(start_j >= james_open, end_j <= james_close, end_j - start_j >= james_min)))
opt.add(Implies(Not(meet_j), And(start_j == 0, end_j == 0)))
opt.add(Implies(meet_r, And(start_r >= robert_open, end_r <= robert_close, end_r - start_r >= robert_min)))
opt.add(Implies(Not(meet_r), And(start_r == 0, end_r == 0)))

opt.add(Implies(And(meet_j, Or(Not(meet_r), j_before_r)), start_j >= arrival_north_beach + 18))
opt.add(Implies(And(meet_r, Or(Not(meet_j), Not(j_before_r))), start_r >= arrival_north_beach + 22))

opt.add(Implies(And(meet_j, meet_r, j_before_r), end_j + 7 <= start_r))
opt.add(Implies(And(meet_j, meet_r, Not(j_before_r)), end_r + 7 <= start_j))

count = If(meet_j, 1, 0) + If(meet_r, 1, 0)
total_end = If(meet_j, end_j, 0) + If(meet_r, end_r, 0)
opt.maximize(count * 10000 - total_end)

if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    meet_j_val = is_true(m.eval(meet_j))
    meet_r_val = is_true(m.eval(meet_r))
    start_j_val = m.eval(start_j).as_long()
    end_j_val = m.eval(end_j).as_long()
    start_r_val = m.eval(start_r).as_long()
    end_r_val = m.eval(end_r).as_long()
    j_before_r_val = is_true(m.eval(j_before_r))

    order = []
    if meet_j_val and meet_r_val:
        if j_before_r_val:
            order = ['J', 'R']
        else:
            order = ['R', 'J']
    elif meet_j_val:
        order = ['J']
    elif meet_r_val:
        order = ['R']

    info = {
        'J': {'name': 'James', 'loc': 'M', 'start': start_j_val, 'end': end_j_val},
        'R': {'name': 'Robert', 'loc': 'C', 'start': start_r_val, 'end': end_r_val},
    }

    itinerary = [f"You start at North Beach at {fmt(arrival_north_beach)}."]
    cur_time = arrival_north_beach
    cur_loc = 'N'

    for p in order:
        d = info[p]
        dest = d['loc']
        dur = travel_time(cur_loc, dest)
        if dur > 0:
            arr = cur_time + dur
            itinerary.append(f"You travel to {loc_name(dest)} in {dur} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arr)}.")
            cur_time = arr
            cur_loc = dest

        if cur_time < d['start']:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(d['start'])}.")
            cur_time = d['start']

        duration = d['end'] - d['start']
        itinerary.append(f"You meet {d['name']} for {duration} minutes from {fmt(d['start'])} to {fmt(d['end'])}.")
        cur_time = d['end']
        cur_loc = dest

    print(itinerary)
else:

START = "Golden Gate Park"
START_TIME = 9 * 60
names = list(friends.keys())


def fmt(t):
    h = t // 60
    m = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{m:02d}{suffix}"


def solve_order(order):
    solver = Solver()
    start_vars = {}
    end_vars = {}

    for name in order:
        info = friends[name]
        start_vars[name] = Int(f"start_{name}")
        end_vars[name] = Int(f"end_{name}")
        s = start_vars[name]
        e = end_vars[name]
        solver.add(s >= info["open"])
        solver.add(e <= info["close"])
        solver.add(e == s + info["dur"])

    prev_loc = START
    for i, name in enumerate(order):
        loc = friends[name]["loc"]
        travel_time = travel[prev_loc][loc]
        if i == 0:
            solver.add(start_vars[name] >= START_TIME + travel_time)
        else:
            prev_name = order[i - 1]
            solver.add(start_vars[name] >= end_vars[prev_name] + travel_time)
        prev_loc = loc

    if solver.check() != sat:
        return None

    model = solver.model()
    itinerary = [f"You start at {START} at {fmt(START_TIME)}."]
    current_loc = START
    current_time = START_TIME

    for name in order:
        loc = friends[name]["loc"]
        travel_time = travel[current_loc][loc]
        arrival = current_time + travel_time
        itinerary.append(
            f"You travel to {loc} in {travel_time} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrival)}."
        )

        start = model.evaluate(start_vars[name]).as_long()
        end = model.evaluate(end_vars[name]).as_long()

        if arrival < start:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(start)}.")

        itinerary.append(f"You meet {name} from {fmt(start)} to {fmt(end)}.")
        current_time = end
        current_loc = loc

    return itinerary


answer = None
for k in range(len(names), -1, -1):
    for order in permutations(names, k):
        result = solve_order(list(order))
        if result is not None:
            answer = result
            break
    if answer is not None:
        break

from z3 import *

names = ["Joseph", "Nancy", "Jason", "Jeffrey"]
locations = ["Bayview", "Russian Hill", "Alamo Square", "North Beach", "Financial District"]

duration = [60, 90, 15, 45]
avail_start = [510, 660, 1005, 630]
avail_end = [1155, 960, 1305, 945]

travel_matrix = [
    [0, 23, 16, 21, 19],
    [23, 0, 15, 5, 11],
    [16, 13, 0, 15, 17],
    [22, 4, 16, 0, 8],
    [19, 10, 17, 7, 0],
]

solver = Solver()

start = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(4)]
end = [Int(f"end_{i}") for i in range(4)]

for i in range(4):
    solver.add(end[i] == start[i] + duration[i])
    solver.add(start[i] >= avail_start[i])
    solver.add(end[i] <= avail_end[i])

seq = [Int(f"seq_{i}") for i in range(4)]
for i in range(4):
    solver.add(seq[i] >= 0, seq[i] < 4)
solver.add(Distinct(seq))


def loc_expr(f):
    return If(f == 0, 1, If(f == 1, 2, If(f == 2, 3, 4)))


def start_expr(f):
    return If(f == 0, start[0], If(f == 1, start[1], If(f == 2, start[2], start[3])))


def end_expr(f):
    return If(f == 0, end[0], If(f == 1, end[1], If(f == 2, end[2], end[3])))


def travel_time(l1, l2):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in range(5):
        for j in range(5):
            expr = If(And(l1 == i, l2 == j), IntVal(travel_matrix[i][j]), expr)
    return expr

    cur_start = start_expr(seq[k])
    if k == 0:
        prev_loc = IntVal(0)
        prev_time = IntVal(540)
    else:
        prev_loc = loc_expr(seq[k - 1])
        prev_time = end_expr(seq[k - 1])

    m = minutes % 60

current_loc = 0

for k in range(4):

    meeting_start = start_vals[friend]

    current_time = meeting_end

        m = t % 60

        h12 = h % 12

            h12 = 12
        return f"{h12}:{m:02d}{suffix}"

    current_time = 540
    current_loc = "Sunset District"

    for idx in order:
        loc = locs[idx]
        tt = travel[(current_loc, loc)]
        arrival = current_time + tt
